name: --ds-easing-out
comment: Fast start, gentle stop: for elements responding to the user.

name: --ds-semantic-color-background-subtle-base
comment: Neutral dark fill (e.g. the secondary Button), not a faint surface: "subtle" means low-chroma, not low-contrast.

name: --ds-semantic-color-background-utility-warning-hover
comment: Lighter, not darker: the text is already the darkest honey (900), so darker hover/active backgrounds fail 4.5:1.

name: --ds-semantic-color-background-utility-warning-active
comment: Lighter, not darker: the text is already the darkest honey (900), so darker hover/active backgrounds fail 4.5:1.

name: --ds-semantic-color-text-subtle-disabled
comment: Secondary text that must stay readable on a disabled field (e.g. an Input unit).

name: --ds-semantic-color-border-subtle-base
comment: Darker than border.default on purpose: a neutral edge that pairs with background.subtle. For faint dividers use border.disabled.

name: --ds-semantic-focus-ring-offset
comment: Stroke geometry, not layout spacing: the gap matches the ring width, so it stays off the 4px spacing scale.

name: --ds-semantic-shadow-raised
comment: Barely-there lift so a control reads as a surface.
